en.name: Peanut butter, stabilised
en.summary: Stabilised peanut butter — the kind that never separates — keeps 6–9 months from purchase unopened in the cupboard and 2–3 months once opened, or 12 months unopened and 3–4 months opened if you keep it refrigerated. It fails by going rancid, not by growing anything.
en.pantry: In a cool, dry, dark cupboard it keeps 6–9 months from purchase unopened, and 2–3 months once the jar is open. The hydrogenated fat or other stabiliser is there to stop the oil separating, which is a texture job rather than a preservative one — the oil still oxidises, it just does so while staying mixed in. There is not enough available water in the jar for bacteria, so the failure you are guarding against is rancidity: a bitter taste and a smell like old paint. Keep the jar away from the hob and out of the sun, and close it properly.
en.fridge: Refrigeration buys real time here: 12 months from purchase unopened at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 3–4 months once opened. Cold slows the oxidation of the fat, which is the whole mechanism of failure, so a large jar you will work through slowly belongs in the fridge. The cost is spreadability — stabilised peanut butter sets firm when cold — so let it stand at room temperature for a few minutes, or keep a small jar in the cupboard for daily use and the big one in the fridge.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for stabilised peanut butter, and a jar that already has a year in the fridge has little to gain. It does freeze without harm, but the whole jar has to thaw before you can use any of it, and the texture comes back slightly grainy. Freezing measured portions in an ice cube tray — for smoothies, satay or baking — is a far more practical use of the freezer than storing the jar.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge, then let it come to room temperature and stir before use. Do not microwave a sealed jar.
spoilage: A sharp, bitter, paint-like smell from oxidised oil.
A bitter or soapy taste in a jar that looks perfectly normal.
A dark, hard, dried crust under the lid.
Mould on the surface or around the rim, almost always from a used knife.
tips: Use a clean dry knife every time; do not double-dip.
Keep the big jar in the fridge and decant a small working jar for the cupboard.
Wipe the rim so the lid seals properly.
Buy the size your household will finish inside the opened window.

faq.q: How long does stabilised peanut butter last after opening?
faq.a: 2–3 months in the cupboard, or 3–4 months refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.

faq.q: Does no-stir peanut butter need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: No, but refrigerating it roughly doubles the unopened life and adds time after opening, because cold slows the oil from going rancid.

faq.q: Why does this kind never separate?
faq.a: It contains hydrogenated fat or another stabiliser that holds the oil in suspension. That is a texture feature, not a preservative — the oil still ages.

zh.name: 含氫化油的市售花生醬
zh.summary: 這種永遠不會出油分離的花生醬，未開封放櫥櫃自購買日起 6～9 個月、開封後 2～3 個月；若改放冷藏，未開封 12 個月、開封後 3～4 個月。它壞掉的方式是走油，不是長菌。
zh.pantry: 陰涼、乾燥、避光的櫥櫃：未開封自購買日起 6～9 個月，開封後 2～3 個月。裡面的氫化油或其他安定劑是為了防止油脂分離，那是質地上的任務而不是防腐——油一樣會氧化，只是它氧化的時候仍然乖乖混在裡面。罐子裡的可利用水分不足以讓細菌生長，所以你要防的是油耗：入口發苦、聞起來像舊油漆。請遠離爐台、避免日曬，並確實蓋緊。
zh.fridge: 這裡冷藏確實換得到時間：未開封放 4 °C 以下可到 12 個月，開封後 3～4 個月。低溫拖慢油脂氧化，而那正是它唯一的失敗機制，所以要慢慢用完的大罐，就該放冰箱。代價是抹不動——穩定型花生醬冰過會變硬——所以用之前先放室溫幾分鐘，或者大罐冰著、另外分一小罐放櫥櫃日常使用。
zh.freezer: 這類花生醬沒有公布的冷凍期限，而一罐冷藏本來就能放一年的東西，從冷凍得到的也有限。冷凍不會傷害它，但要用一點就得整罐解凍，而且回來的質地會微微帶砂。把需要的份量挖進製冰盒冷凍——做果昔、沙嗲或烘焙用——比冷凍整罐實際得多。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，再回到室溫並攪勻後使用。不要把密封罐直接微波。
spoilage: 聞起來尖銳發苦、像舊油漆，這是油脂氧化。
外觀完全正常，但吃起來發苦或帶肥皂味。
蓋子底下結出一層變深、變硬的乾殼。
表面或罐口長霉，幾乎都來自用過的刀。
tips: 每次都用乾淨乾燥的刀，不要重複沾取。
大罐冰冷藏，另外分一小罐放櫥櫃當日常用。
擦乾淨罐口，蓋子才能密合。
買開封期限內用得完的容量。

faq.q: 免攪拌花生醬開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 放櫥櫃 2～3 個月，或冷藏 4 °C 以下 3～4 個月。

faq.q: 免攪拌花生醬需要冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 不一定，但冷藏大約能把未開封期限拉長一倍，開封後也多撐一些，因為低溫會拖慢油耗。

faq.q: 為什麼這種花生醬不會出油？
faq.a: 因為含有氫化油或其他安定劑把油懸住。那是質地設計，不是防腐劑，油脂一樣會老化。
